title: Karbala Karbala
body:
Aa rahi hai sada
Karbala Karbala x2
Karbala Karbala Karbala karbala
Waris e ambiya Zulm sehta raha......
Karbala Karbala Karbala karbala
Maut roti rahi sar jhukaye hue
Khaakh nauha padhe mooh chupaye hue
Sina Akbar ka teero se jab chid gaya......
Hoke Qasim ka pamal sara badan
Leke gathri me laaye the shahe zaman
Ek kohram tha ek meshar bapa......
Laash Aun O Mohammed ki jab aagayi
Gir gayi khaakh par haye Binte Ali
Maa ne sajda Kiya kehke shukre Khuda......
Baazu e bawafa kat Gaye neher par
Ek Bazu Idhar ek Bazu udhar
Reh gaya tashnalab Aaj tak alqama......
Sheh ki aagosh me chota quraan tha
Jiske hasne pa zalim bhi hairaan tha
Chid gaya dasht me Uska pyasa gala......
Jo Nabuwat Imamat ki pehchaan hai
Asre aashur Uska yeh elaan hai
Mera Nana Nabi
Meri Maa sayyada.....
Aagayi shaam e Ghum Zulm taaza huwe
Chin gayi baaliyan Aur tamache lage
Roke baali sakina ne nauha padha......
Aagaye chor kar jab Najaf Murtaza
Jod kar haath kehne lagi Aalema
Baba main loot gayi mere sar ki Rida.....
Kaise momin Ada ho ghamo ki aza'n
Karbala se Ae Yawar chala karwa'n
Ya Hussaina Hussain ki Goonji sada.....
Karbala Karbala Karbala karbala
